## Purpose
A shadcn/ui primitive (new-york style): A hover tooltip (Tooltip, TooltipTrigger, TooltipContent, TooltipProvider).

## Responsibilities
- Wraps @radix-ui/react-tooltip with the project's Tailwind token classes.
- Exports the parts listed under Purpose.
- 32 lines. It has no project-specific logic: it imports only `cn` from `@/lib/utils` and other `ui` primitives.
